title: One line of analyzers.jsonl
description: Everything that decides an analysis except the image. id is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the other keys (imagekit/analyzer.py); a change to any of them is a new analyzer.

model_revision.description: a Hugging Face commit, a weights file's hash, or an API model's id and date

rules_version.description: git commit of photo-rules/ the prompt was built from

prompt_hash.description: first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the assembled prompt, without the image

params.description: image_px, effort, temperature, views, region kind and anything else that changes the output
